failing_checks.title: Per-action amount bound
failing_checks.reason: The deposit payment amount is amount_in minus amount_fee. Both come from the rails integration or the DB. No maximum is checked before signing. Asset min/max is enforced only at the request-time form or API. The watch_transactions path overwrites amount_in with the on-chain amount, so an overpayment

failing_checks.title: Cumulative budget
failing_checks.reason: No cumulative per-day, per-account or per-asset budget exists on any payout path. Only per-transaction min/max is enforced.

failing_checks.title: Atomic budget accounting
failing_checks.reason: Claiming rows via select_for_update plus pending_execution_attempt prevents double processing of the same transaction. No budget exists to account atomically, so the check fails.

failing_checks.title: Incoming payment verification
failing_checks.reason: The checks are good: it requires successful, a destination equal to the distribution account, and code plus issuer. The weak points are that the match is by memo alone, with the first row taken if memos collide. The amount is not compared with the expected amount, because amount_in is overwritten wi

failing_checks.title: Expiry and fees
failing_checks.reason: The deposit payment envelope and the create-account envelope (line 129) are built with no set_timeout and no timebounds. The envelope is also persisted as envelope_xdr and can be submitted later. testnet.py does use set_timeout(30).

failing_checks.title: Submission outcome
failing_checks.reason: submit() checks response["successful"], but only BaseHorizonError is caught around the submit. A connection error, timeout or post-send KeyError (for example response["paging_token"]) is caught by this generic handler. It marks the transaction error although the payment may have landed. failing_checks.title: Failure and rollback paths
failing_checks.reason: The account-creation failure path sets error but does not reset pending_execution_attempt, which the other error paths do. It can leave a lock marker set. failing_checks.title: Secret handling
failing_checks.reason: Testnet command prints issuer, distributor and client seeds to stdout, where logs may capture them.

failing_checks.title: Outbound requests and file paths
failing_checks.reason: The client-supplied on_change_callback only gets a URLValidator check and a substring denylist (sep24/utils.py:205). There is no private-IP or resolved-address check, so internal hosts can be targeted.

failing_checks.title: Controls outside the prompt
failing_checks.reason: Payout limits and submission reconciliation are not enforced in code. This is already recorded in earlier findings.

failing_checks.title: Core function works
failing_checks.reason: A submit exception sets the transaction to error without rechecking whether the transaction landed on the ledger. The status can then be wrong.
